greeting: A completely clear day, Dan: nothing on the calendar today and just a 9am tomorrow. What actually needs you is a short run of bookings whose windows are closing this week.

needsAttention.title: December break still isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: The three-week holiday trip for all six has a book-by date of Oct 15 — two days out — and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. The domestic-vs-international call is still open, and it decides whether you can book at all before passports arrive.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental is open
needsAttention.detail: The p1 'book this week' task — a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, the only six-seater up there once the Pathfinder heads south. A refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the whole sell-out risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Dr Snowden at 9am tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Your only calendar entry in the next two days is a 9am appointment Tuesday. With today wide open, the morning's clear to make it.
